notablePrerequisites:
Forests and green creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{U}.
Quicksilver Elemental does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Cast Viridescent Wisps by paying {G}, causing Quicksliver Elemental to become green until end of turn.
Activate all Forests and green mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental by paying {U}, causing it to gain all abilities from Patron of the Orochi until end of turn.
Activate Quicksliver Elemental using Patron of the Orochi's ability by tapping it, untapping all Forests and green creatures you control.
Repeat from step 2.
